subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Nova Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Nova Retail

Hi Liam — thanks again for the intro and taking time to walk through Nova's use case today. Quick recap from my side and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

Call recap
- Primary use case: personalized product recommendations and checkout assist within Nova's web and mobile experiences
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency < 200ms p95 for core flows, unit cost per 1k tokens, and security/compliance evidence (SOC2 + encryption at rest)
- Timeline: vendor shortlist and security reviews planned in late Feb / early Mar; procurement sign-off target mid-March

Stakeholder map (from call)
- You (Liam O'Connor) — product sponsor / champion
- Caroline Tan — VP Finance / economic buyer (you mentioned she owns vendor approvals)
- Samir Patel — Head of InfoSec (security intake / procurement gating)
- Engineering leads (implementation) — TBD

Asks / next steps
1) Can you share a short org chart (or a list of names/emails) for the procurement & security stakeholders? That helps us prepare the right materials and tailor the risk/security docs.
2) Would you be able to intro Caroline and Samir on an email thread? We propose a 30-min intro to align on procurement and security requirements.
3) I will attach a one-pager and a mutual action plan template — please review and we can iterate.

Proposed next meeting: 30-min intro next week (Wed or Thu) — what works for Caroline & Samir?

Attached: Redwood_Product_OnePager.pdf (one-pager), Mutual_Action_Plan_Nova.xlsx (MAMP template)

Thanks — looking forward to the org chart and intros.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0122

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Nova Retail

Thanks Marissa — great recap and aligned. Attaching a lightweight org chart; I'll also introduce Caroline and Samir on the thread after I confirm their availability. Quick answers below: 

- Org chart attached (see Nova_OrgChart_v2.pdf) — Caroline (VP Finance) and Samir (Head of InfoSec) listed with emails.
- Procurement timeline: vendor short-listing complete by end of Feb; security intake/third-party review in early March; final budget approval expected ~mid-March.
- Pricing: would appreciate a ballpark/upper-bound for a POC and expected run-rate (monthly) for 5M tokens/month.
- Security evidence: SOC2 report + data handling summary required for their intake form. If you can surface those docs that'd help.

I can intro Caroline and Samir once I confirm their calendars — likely this week or early next. Thanks for the MAMP and one-pager.

Best,
Liam
Director of Product Partnerships | Nova Retail
liam.oconnor@novaretail.com
[Attachment: Nova_OrgChart_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novaretail.com>, Caroline Tan <caroline.tan@novaretail.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@nova-sec.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Nova Retail

Hi Liam, Caroline, Samir — thanks for joining. Quick intro: I'm Marissa (AE at Redwood). We help teams run production-grade LLM inference with controls for latency, cost, and security.

Caroline / Samir — per my call with Liam, high-level asks from Nova include:
- Latency and cost targets for recommended configuration
- SOC2 report and data handling summary for security intake
- Procurement steps and expected timeline (Liam indicated mid-March budget approval)

Attached: Redwood_Product_OnePager.pdf (short product brief), Mutual_Action_Plan_Nova.xlsx (MAMP draft).

Proposed next steps
1) Quick technical + security Q&A with Samir (20-30 min) to cover SOC2, encryption, key management, and data flows
2) Short procurement intro with Caroline to review commercial terms and procurement timeline
3) Provide a ballpark pricing slide for a 5M tokens/month workload (we'll flag assumptions)

Aditya — could you confirm who from our security/solutions engineering team should join the call and whether we should share SOC2 + encryption summary first?

Proposed meeting windows: Thu 12 Feb 10:00-11:30 PST or Wed 18 Feb 10:00-12:00 PST. Liam — which works better?

Thanks all — happy to adjust.

Best,
Marissa
[Attachments: Redwood_Product_OnePager.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_Nova.xlsx]
